The images are ready. Your workspace defines exactly one view, so there's one image:

- **`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the System Context view (Patron → Library over HTTPS), rendered in standard C4 style: person and software-system shapes with the official C4 colors (`#084270` / `#1168bd`), relationship label with `[HTTPS]` technology, and the C4 legend.

How it was done, and one caveat:

1. `workspace.dsl` validated cleanly (the inspect notes are just recommendations — e.g., the containers aren't on the view, which is normal for a system context view).
2. I exported the view to C4-PlantUML via the structurizr tool, but this environment has **no local renderer** (no Java/Node/PlantUML/Mermaid CLI) and **no external network** (DNS fails, so the public PlantUML server is unreachable).
3. So I hand-built the SVG to match the exported definition exactly. It's well-formed (tag balance verified) and will open in any browser or vector editor.

I also kept **`/work/SystemContext.puml`** — the exact C4-PlantUML source. If you ever want a pixel-perfect PNG, paste that file into [plantuml.com](https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml) or run it with a local PlantUML install. Delete it if you don't need it.
